name: Villarrubia de los Ojos (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villarrubia de los Ojos (a cross of Calatrava on white and roundels on red).
history: Municipal flag of Villarrubia de los Ojos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villarrubia de los Ojos arms — cross of Calatrava and roundels
